The verdict is fraud with an initial and final fraud probability of 0.9, supported by historical case matches and high-risk indicators. Initial and final actions include blocking the card (L1 recommended, pending approval), filing a report (L2 recommended, pending approval), creating a case (auto), monitoring connected cards (auto), and escalating to an analyst (auto).
